candidates.tagline: Your LG TV is still listening after you 'turn it off'
candidates.story: A 500-hour, $70,000 Gamers Nexus and Level1Techs investigation published September 7–8, 2026 proved that LG smart TVs record room audio and scan every device on your home Wi-Fi network even in standby — directly contradicting LG's own July 2026 public statement that the TVs 'do not collect, record or store ambient conversations.'
candidates.why_funny: LG looked into the camera, said 'we don't record ambient conversations,' and then left the microphone running while the camera was off.
candidates.alt: A sleek LG smart TV mounted on a wall in a modern living room, its screen dark as if switched off, appearing perfectly innocent

candidates.tagline: You installed a wallpaper app. Microsoft installed a Harry Potter billboard.
candidates.story: Microsoft's Bing Wallpaper app delivered a full-screen Harry Potter 'Now Available' promotional ad as users' Windows 11 desktop backgrounds on September 8, 2026 — people who had opted in for scenic photography instead found a Warner Bros. marketing image covering their entire desktop, triggering mass uninstalls.
candidates.why_funny: The app whose one job is 'show a pretty picture behind your icons' delivered a movie poster, and users responded the way everyone responds to pop-up ads: by making it stop existing on their computer.
candidates.alt: A Windows 11 desktop background taken over entirely by a large Harry Potter film promotional advertisement with prominent 'Now Available' text, where a scenic landscape photo should be
